analysis: Upper-road plateaus are 35.39-35.48 m at x=-104..-110 and 35.51-35.65 m at x=97..105 across z=-4..+4. The lower samples at x=-97..-103 and beyond x=106 are slope/underpass transitions, not an unbiased road target. Fit the model to the upper road surfaces at the actual connection polygons rather than matching the smoothed quay slope.
